findings.status: resolved in current observed code; original failure evidence retained; independent recheck passed
findings.trigger: Both old independent config and registry exist; confirmed clear first commits legacy clear, then registry rename fails.
findings.historicalActual: Controlled error said original file remains unchanged. Registry did remain byte-identical with old usable key, but independent config had already lost its key. Failed operation was partially committed.
findings.effect: The confirmation remains open and failure wording does not accurately describe two-file state. Single-file fixture coverage does not verify this service composition.
findings.remediation: Actual service now uses one secureStore.clearCredentials plan. It preflights/freezes both current files, conditionally commits, restores in reverse on failure, refuses to overwrite observed external changes, reports incomplete rollback accurately and invalidates the manager cache.
